name: James Halloran
summary: James Halloran is a human tanner working out of the Wetlands to supply fine hides across the eastern continents. Based in Menethil Harbor, he makes a living harvesting the tough, prized skins of the region's native crocolisks. He relies on passing travelers and nearby trade channels to gather raw materials and transport his finished leathers to market.

sections.title: A Tanner in the Marshes
sections.body: From his home in Menethil Harbor, James Halloran makes his living from the marshland just outside town. As an enterprising tanner, Halloran recognized that the perilous bogs offer a lucrative commodity: crocolisk skins. Transforming the rugged hide of marsh reptiles into high-quality leather requires rare craftsmanship, and Halloran's finished goods are shipped out through local trade channels to buyers all across Azeroth.

sections.title: Hides, Apprentices, and Daily Trade
sections.body: Operating so close to the marsh comes with constant danger. Halloran cannot easily hunt every beast himself while tending to curing vats and trade logistics. He frequently hires hardy travelers to handle the rougher chores of skinning young marsh beasts and managing routine deliveries between his work site and surrounding settlements, ensuring his bustling leather craft stays fully supplied.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a human tanner based in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He specializes in hunting and skinning the region's indigenous crocolisks, curing their tough hides into leather goods that are exported across the world.

faq.q: Where does James Halloran sell his leather?
faq.answer: Halloran processes raw crocolisk skins into fine leathers and ships them throughout Azeroth. He relies heavily on the maritime trade passing through Menethil Harbor to distribute his wares across the seas.

faq.q: Why does Halloran need adventurers to collect young crocolisk skins?
faq.answer: Curing and tanning leather is time-consuming, labor-intensive work. Halloran employs traveling adventurers to cull the local marsh crocolisks and strip their hides so that he has a steady supply of raw material without abandoning his workshop.

faq.q: What is Halloran's connection to Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor serves as the primary trade and supply hub for the region. Halloran relies on the harbor and its shipping lanes to export his cured hides to distant markets and keep his tanning business viable.

faq.q: Where can James Halloran be found?
faq.answer: Halloran lives and works in Menethil Harbor, the busy port on the western coast of the Wetlands, with the crocolisk marshes right outside town.

Yes. Halloran sent his apprentice, whom he thinks of like a son, into the marshes to skin giant crocolisks, but the young man was mauled and lost a leg. While the apprentice recovers, Halloran relies on hardy travelers to gather the skins his trade depends on.

angles.text: Halloran's trade helps sustain the commercial presence of the Alliance in the rugged Wetlands, supplying valuable crafted leather to towns across the kingdom.
Hunters navigating the sodden marshes will find common ground with Halloran, whose livelihood depends on stalking and harvesting the wetlands' aggressive reptilian predators.
